name: todo
description: Atomic repository task routing with optional YAML execution pipelines, persistent threads, deterministic gates, and telemetry.

interface.longDescription: Decomposes repository mutations into an atomic task DAG, optionally executes repository-defined YAML pipelines with Codex and deterministic shell gates, preserves persistent per-task threads across repair turns, and sends merge delivery through a singleton local rebase queue. Connector and Git preflight, bounded failure receipts, owner-thread dashboard lifecycle, and attempt telemetry remain durable and repository-local.
defaultPrompt: Use $todo:route to route this repository change through ToDo.
Use $todo:run with a referenced task file to execute it in this thread.
Use $todo:status to show tasks and workers.
